purpose:
Read-only screening of large Gaussians against observed training feature rays.

An actually observed static feature supplies empty space before its 3D location.
This tests negative visibility evidence, never distance to a holed mesh or sparse
point support. It does not remove geometry. The projection is a local Gaussian
linearization; any proposed removal still needs before/after render validation.
selection: Source max scale >0.05 normalized units and opacity >0.1. At least four distinct training timestamps supply >80% negative versus positive witness timestamps.
rayQualification: Masked SfM observations; track length >=6; stored error <=1.5 native pixels; actual reprojection residual <=2 native pixels. Known feature range must exceed the Gaussian conditional mean +3 sigma +5% feature range. No eval timestamps used.
caveats: Local fisheye Jacobian approximation; not an exact volumetric renderer
Nearest eight observed features per projected centre; a screening test rather than exhaustive ray coverage
No candidates may be deleted without checking the final checkpoint and all source views
